claims.text: The latest stable Pulumi release is v3.261.0 (2026-09-02) per the comparison table (L134), while the license table and Pulumi section list v3.263.0 (2026-09-16); the Pulumi CLI latest stable release is as of 2026-09-21.
The latest stable Terraform release is v1.16.1 (2026-09-02) in the at-a-glance table, and v1.16.3 (2026-09-16) in the license table and Terraform section.
The latest stable AWS CDK release is v2.268.0 (2026-09-02) in the at-a-glance table, and v2.270.0 (2026-09-17) in the license table and CDK section.
The latest stable Azure Bicep release is v0.46.1 (2026-07-30) in the at-a-glance table, and v0.47.16 (2026-09-08) in the license table and Bicep section.
The latest stable Kubernetes release is v1.37.0, released 2026-08-26.
The latest stable Crossplane release is v2.4.0 (2026-08-20) in the at-a-glance table, and v2.4.1 (2026-09-15) in the license table and Crossplane section.
The latest stable OpenTofu release is v1.12.6, released 2026-08-19.
Version and release-date figures were checked against each project's GitHub releases on 2026-09-21.
GitHub star counts: Pulumi ~25.7k, Terraform ~49.7k, AWS CDK ~12.9k, Azure Bicep ~3.6k, Kubernetes ~127.9k, Crossplane ~12.1k, OpenTofu ~30.2k, measured 2026-09-21.
Terraform is the most-starred dedicated IaC tool, followed by OpenTofu, Pulumi, AWS CDK, and Crossplane; Kubernetes leads the broader ecosystem by stars.
Spacelift's paid plans scale by private worker count rather than seats or resources, with quote-based pricing at the top end.
env zero (formerly env0) prices its paid tiers per successful apply or environment.
Google Cloud Deployment Manager reached end of support on March 31, 2026, with the service fully turned down on June 30, 2027.
Google Cloud Infrastructure Manager replaces Google Cloud Deployment Manager.
Pulumi Cloud's Free edition is free forever for one user with unlimited stacks and projects and 500 workflow minutes per month.
Pulumi Cloud Essentials starts at $40/month with 40 credits included and up to 500 managed resources.
Pulumi Cloud Pro starts at $400/month with 400 credits included and up to 2,000 managed resources.
Pulumi Cloud Enterprise pricing is custom and contract-priced.

HCP Terraform is free for up to 500 managed resources with one concurrent run, then per-resource pricing of roughly $0.10 to $0.99 per resource per month depending on tier; Terraform Enterprise is self-hosted at custom pricing.
Pricing figures reflect published pricing as of September 2026, checked on 2026-09-21.
